title: Bibliopolis topic tree
description: The topics of a collection as a forest: every node names its parent. What a schema cannot say (an id used once, a parent that exists, no cycle, at most 64 levels, a bucket that is a root) the program checks; see docs/format.md.

bucket.description: Optional. The id of a node that is a root: the root bucket, the home of what is not sorted yet. It and everything below it are not places of the tree (no road, no sector, no mirror road); an item filed only there stands on the ring road. The program checks that the id is the id of a root node.

id.description: Unique in the tree; no control characters.

label.description: The name shown for the road.

parent.description: The id of the parent node, or null for a root.
